title: IdleSMP Modpack
description: The Official Modpack of IdleSMP, featuring Cobblemon x Create.
body:
### **The Official Modpack of IdleSMP** _for neoforge_

## **About This Modpack:**

The IdleSMP modpack is designed to make your Minecraft experience smoother, more immersive, and ready for adventure. It includes custom UIs, optimized performance, and quality-of-life features that improve gameplay without straying too far from vanilla Minecraft.

Optional extras, like recommended resource packs or shaders, are available but disabled by default, so you can choose how you want to experience the world. The modpack also integrates direct server access from the main menu, making joining IdleSMP effortless and seamless. Updates are handled through the launcher, so you’ll always have the latest features without needing to reinstall.

Whether you’re here for exploration, building, or catching all the Cobblemon, IdleSMP is built to give you the best experience right from day one.

## **Technical Details:**
- Recommended to run with a minimum of 2.5 GB of memory. Use 3 GB or more for best performance.
- This modpack is for Neoforge **1.21.1** only.
